description: A person settles an open stop request (S55 T5, LC15): the request moves open→dismissed exactly once (the store's compare-and-set; a decided or missing request is a typed refusal — see loop-control-refused-not-open), the decider is stamped from the connection, and the loop is UNTOUCHED — a dismissal is the person's "noted, not acting", never a control act on the loop itself (stopping it remains loop.stop). The settlement emits loop.control.dismissed so the desk's screen updates.
